audit_meta.title: B5 Adaptation-vs-Test Distribution & Leakage Scientific Audit

audit_a_identity_leakage.verdict: Strict base-level isolation confirmed. Zero identity leakage.

audit_b_text_duplication.verdict: Zero exact or normalized full-text duplication between adaptation and test sets.

audit_c_template_overlap.verdict: Adaptation templates use synthetic corporate/administrative framing while test templates use standard benchmark carrier patterns. Zero exact carrier skeleton overlap.

audit_d_lexical_overlap.verdict: Lexical overlap is low (overall Jaccard ~0.20, context Jaccard ~0.12), driven strictly by domain-essential terminology (e.g. 'account', 'card', 'number', Indian street suffixes).

audit_e_pii_format_overlap.verdict: Synthetic PII generators share deterministic regex/formatting constraints across splits (e.g., Aadhaar 4-4-4 spacing, UPI bank handles, PAN regex). Model learns generator signatures rather than unconstrained semantic PII concepts, inducing high recall and high FPR on lookalikes.

audit_f_language_overlap.verdict: Zero-shot transfer verified on unseen test language categories (INFORMAL_HINGLISH, HI_LATIN_PII).

audit_g_perturbation_overlap.verdict: Zero adversarial perturbation overlap. Adversarial evaluation on B5 is 100% zero-shot.

audit_h_hard_negative_overlap.verdict: Complete absence of negative distractor training instances in adaptation corpus explains 100% hard-negative FPR on test set.

audit_i_classifier_diagnostic.classifier: Top-1000 Word/Bigram BoW Linear Classifier (5-Fold CV)
audit_i_classifier_diagnostic.verdict: Near-perfect distinguishability (100% CV accuracy) confirms strong carrier distribution shift between adaptation and test datasets.

audit_j_pii_value_memorization.overlap_details: 4 common Indian name collisions across random sampling pools in PERSON; 0.00% overlap in all other 7 structured PII categories.
audit_j_pii_value_memorization.verdict: Zero value memorization across structured Indian identifiers.

risk_summary_table.evidence: Exact and normalized full-text match count is 0 / 964
0 exact skeleton matches between adaptation corporate framing and test carrier patterns
Context vocabulary Jaccard similarity is 0.1213; 2-gram Jaccard is 0.0772
Identical synthetic generators used across splits (rigid PAN regex, Aadhaar 4-4-4 spacing, UPI handles)
risk_summary_table.consequence: Model exploits formatting shortcuts, driving high sensitivity.

risk_summary_table.evidence: High recall (100%) on unseen categories (INFORMAL_HINGLISH, HI_LATIN_PII)
0 negative instances in adaptation vs 100 in test
risk_summary_table.consequence: Explains 100% FPR on hard negatives and 55.80% overall FPR.

risk_summary_table.evidence: Dense positive-only training on generator-formatted strings causes high recall + high FPR
risk_summary_table.consequence: Model behaves as a dense format detector rather than semantic filter.

highest_risk_issue: Synthetic generator formatting shortcut risk & total absence of hard-negative training distractors in adaptation corpus.
controlled_holdout_recommendation: A controlled holdout with real-world/naturalistic Indian PII and negative distractors is recommended for future benchmark phases, but B5 meets all specification requirements for Baseline Pilot v0.1.
b5_freeze_recommendation: B5 remains FROZEN and LOCKED as the canonical adapted baseline.
